title: Shredder
description: Just the shredder head, drawn like an iOS 6 icon: brushed aluminium, a stitched leather band and a green glass button. Push a top-song sleeve into the slot and it hums and pulls it through; sixteen strips of the cover hang from the blades, then drop away out of the bottom of the frame while the next sleeve slides down from above.
intent: One paper mechanic in a flat, layered 2D object: the sleeve is sliced into real strips of the cover that hang, sway and fall away, with nothing else on stage.
